title: Settings UI: brokers, reference data, business rules, business assignments
objective: Tenant-scoped Settings section with vertical tab navigation showing only permitted subsections: Brokers, Reference data, Business rules, Business assignments (API access tab added by T-030) — spec FR-18..FR-24, PRD 12.10.
scope: Settings layout with vertical tabs, per-subsection permission gating
Brokers tab: list/add/edit/disable + contacts editor with primary flag
Reference data tab: list-type navigation, add/edit/disable/reorder per 6.2 with guarded-status affordances
Business rules tab: full FR-11 form incl. currency and attachment cap
Business assignments tab: lead/quote assignable role pickers + accountable-owner radio
out_of_scope: Global template editor (Internal-only; included here only as a scoped variant when global.manage_templates)
implementation_details: features/settings/SettingsLayout.tsx: vertical tab nav rendering only subsections whose permission the user holds (settings nav item visible if any); routes /settings/{tab}
BrokersTab: table + BrokerFormDrawer (name required, tier dropdown from reference data, branch, status) + ContactsEditor (rows with name/email/phone, primary radio); disable confirm dialog

ReferenceDataTab: left list-type selector (11 types), right table with drag or up/down reorder (POST /reorder), add/edit inline drawer; status lists show reporting-category column (read-only for canonical rows), disable button hidden for is_terminal rows, category picker restricted to open/quoted for new intermediate statuses; cover types grouped under a product-line selector; request channels show broker-channel toggle
BusinessRulesTab: sectioned form (Currency & formats / Thresholds & SLA / Workflow rules) matching FR-11 fields with inline validation mirroring backend rules; save via PUT /settings/business-rules
BusinessAssignmentsTab: two panels (Leads / Quotes) with role multi-selects from tenant roles, accountable-owner radio within lead panel; warning copy about roles in use
settingsApi RTK Query module; all forms follow UI-standards validation display

e2e: settings.spec.ts: user with only brokers permission sees only Brokers tab; add broker with primary contact; rename a lead status and verify chip label changes while reporting category fixed; terminal status has no disable action; reorder request channels persists; set high-value threshold + currency and verify footer/currency prefix updates; configure lead assignable roles with accountable owner

findings.description: Reorder disabled-exclusion is not regression-locked. ReferenceDataTab.test.tsx reorder test uses an all-active fixture, and the reorder e2e reorders two freshly-added active channels, so neither would catch a regression that leaks a disabled id into the reorder payload or renders reorder controls on a disabled row (the exact bug fixed this iteration).
findings.recommendation: Add a component test with a mixed active/disabled fixture asserting (a) reorder payload contains only active ids and (b) disabled rows render no reorder-up/reorder-down controls. Non-blocking.

findings.description: Brokers best-effort 403 fallback is not asserted. BrokersTab.test.tsx mocks listReferenceItems to resolve [] (never rejects), and the live brokers-only e2e doesn't assert the broker table actually loaded, so the fix (reference-data 403 must not fail the whole Brokers tab) is not locked by an assertion.
findings.recommendation: Add a test where listReferenceItems rejects with a 403-shaped error and assert brokers-table still renders (Type dropdown degraded/empty). Non-blocking.

findings.description: CROSS-CUTTING PRE-EXISTING GAP (tracked against tenant-creation/switch flow, T-006/T-014 - NOT a T-016 defect): no UI path lets an Internal user enter a tenant they are not an explicit member of. CreateTenantCommandHandler grants the creator no user_tenant membership, GetMe sources memberships from the user's real memberships only, and TenantSwitcher offers only those login-time memberships with no view-any-tenant 'enter tenant' action. Consequence: V-007's post-create reference-data-visibility-under-Settings scenario cannot run end to end (kept test.fixme in tenant-manager.spec.ts). T-009 backend seeding is proven by TenantSeedingTests; T-016 reference-data visibility (AC-017/AC-018) is fully exercised in a tenant the user IS a member of. Also relevant to the T-042 POC demo journey.
findings.evidence: CreateTenantCommandHandler.cs:40-88 (no membership grant); GetMeQueryHandler.cs:48-59 (memberships from user's own); tenant-manager.spec.ts:127-165 (V-007 fixme).
findings.recommendation: Track as a follow-up on the tenant creation/switch flow: either grant the creator a membership on CreateTenant, or add a global.view_any_tenant 'enter tenant' action; then un-fixme tenant-manager.spec.ts V-007. Resolve before/within T-042. Non-blocking for T-016.
